method: Read frozen plan and original identity/environment references; viewed each selected original candidate separately before making observations. Did not read generation prompts, boards, old art, root conclusions or other review artifacts. No numeric quality scores.

actors.observation: The adults and three-legged machine preserve their identities. Nera additionally acquires a cheek cut that was not visibly established in the prior impact.

event.observation: The shutter's lower edge overlaps a machine limb, but the composition does not depict the required separation after escape. Odo still loosely holds a cord end; release is suggested by slack rather than clearly shown. The machine, adults, water and shutter-facing wall occupy one continuous foreground/gallery-facing side of the door. Placing the machine left and adults right does not put the adults through the opening onto the other side; the wall does not separate their spaces.

contact.observation: A foreleg overlaps the shutter's near lower edge, but both adults and creature remain on the same visible side; this does not establish a limb traversing a barrier that separates them.

props.observation: Odo retains the upright capped flask. Nera holds a jagged staff remnant and a second segment lies on the floor. A reddish mark is visible at her staff-holding right hand, although it is small. Charge and unlock state are unassessed.
